label: Single Sign-On (Capella)
type: authentication mechanism - proving who you are, a genuinely separate axis from authorization (capella-role:*, what you're allowed to do)
note: Confirmed as a distinct axis throughout this wave's organizations/ui-auth batch: SSO/MFA never becomes a role and is never granted directly. The two axes touch only via gating - Organization Owner is required to configure realms/identity providers/teams (requiresCapellaRole), and role-mapping (sso:group-mapping) is the one place authentication output feeds into authorization. New capella-role/rbac-role/sgw-role/role 'role' family stays entirely on the authorization side - authentication got its own namespace instead of being folded in.
